description.content:
**This file forms part of Mplify 123.1** 
This API implements Business Requirements described in MEF 57.2 and Mplify 57.2.1

Product Order Management allows the Buyer to request the Seller to initiate and complete the
fulfillment process of an installation of a Product Offering, an update to
an existing Product, or a disconnect of an existing Product at the address
defined by the Buyer.

List of supported Use Cases:

- Send Notifications

- Initiate Charge
